<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 134.10955, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of approximately 133.102 Da. The formula C₁₀H₁₃ matches this exact mass within experimental error (the calculated exact mass is 133.10173 Da). No oxygen or other heteroatoms are required to fit the mass, so the molecular formula is C10H13.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
